title: Darius Gaiden
overview:
Now, the Silver Hawk heads into a new battle!

- Staking the hopes of the people, the last two ships take flight -

- The biggest volume in the series: 28 stages in all, including branches
- A faithful port of the arcade version: every element faithfully recreated
- 2-player simultaneous play

今、シルバーホークは新たなる戦いへ！

～人々の望みを賭け、最後の２機が飛び立つ～

●シリーズ最大のボリューム●
～分岐も含め全28ステージ～
●アーケード版を忠実に移植●
～あらゆる要素を忠実に再現～
●二人同時プレイ可能●
